contracts: (Each populated legacy fixture reports successful startup migration and retained-data readback with nonzero test count.) AND (The ownership-preservation selector passes with stable owner and record identity comparison and nonzero discovery.) AND (The restart/reuse selector passes using the same database file and confirms retained-data operations with nonzero discovery.) AND (The targeted artifact-preservation selector passes with nonzero discovery and persisted before/after identity comparison.)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests compares artifact identities and payloads before migration with values after restart and reuse, failing on loss, replacement, or reassignment.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests compares pre-migration and post-reuse ownership mappings and fails on reassignment, loss, corruption, or requester-derived ownership.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests restarts against the original migrated database path and fails if reopening, schema validation, or retained-data operations fail or recreate storage.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests runs each populated old-schema fixture through service-startup migration and fails when upgrade or retained-data readback fails.
